dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Slightly concave spline on the trailing edge with a posterior sweep beginning at the mid-height of the fin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape with a sharp pixel radius at the terminal point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin positioned at approximately a 65-degree angle relative to the dorsal ridge axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1:1 ratio between the maximum base width and the vertical height of the fin.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius convex curve defining the melon from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short pixel length with a high thickness-to-length ratio, resulting in a blunt beak appearance.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the pixel coordinate where the descending melon slope meets the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform, high-saturation cyan/green monochromatic pixel coloration throughout the entirety of the visible silhouette.
